text:
Morgan (CEO): Quick cadence note + three asks for the week. High level: product momentum is good, but we're seeing a tail of higher 99p latency on long-context requests and a slight uptick in token spend. Small list of priorities below. :seedling:
Priya (VP Product): Thanks — appreciate the snapshot. Can you call out any customer-impacting items?
Morgan (CEO): No major customer-facing incidents this week, but two enterprise trials saw slower than expected cold-starts. Not outages, just degraded UX for 30-60s warmups. We need mitigation before next Friday. :warning:
Diego (VP Eng): Noted. We're already rolling a patch to warmup scheduling. Will monitor. ETA for canary tomorrow AM.
Sam (Head of Ops): Also scheduling a maintenance window Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC to deploy infra change for prefix cache eviction. I'll post the outage note in #status and update the status page.
Aisha (Eng Manager): Patch contains a config toggle `enable_steady_warmup=true`. We'll start with 10% traffic and ramp. I'll add canary metrics to the console dashboard.
Morgan (CEO): Top asks (priority order):
1) Stabilize 99p latency for common long-context profiles to <= 350ms by EOD Friday. (Diego/Aisha)
2) Drop token unit cost directionally by 10-15% this quarter via batching + quantization recommendations. (Priya + Eng + Opt team)
3) Finalize EU Private GA checklist: data residency, KMS + audit playbook, and sales enablement one-pager. Target: next Tues COB. (Sam + Priya)
Priya (VP Product): We're on track for the one-pager. Need final legal thumbs-up on the audit wording — pinging @legal.
Diego (VP Eng): For ask #1: running two experiments — adaptive KV priming and a warmup pool. Early canary shows 20% 99p reduction on 8k seq tests. Will post graphs in #eng-runtime.
Aisha (Eng Manager): Also adding a shortterm mitigation: extend prefetch TTL for active routes. Low-risk toggle.
oncall-bot: Deploy canary to pool-b tomorrow 05:00 UTC — CI pipeline ID `ci/4823`.
Sam (Head of Ops): For EU GA: Ops will own the rollout runbook and the incident comms template. I'll share the draft by EOD Wed.
Morgan (CEO): A couple quick metrics to watch this week: weekly active routes +7% MoM, avg token cost +4% WoW, 99p latency (long-context) +12% WoW. Please annotate anomalies in the console so we can tie regressions to changes.
Priya (VP Product): Echo — product teams will freeze non-critical UI changes for the week to avoid noise.
Diego (VP Eng): If the warmup canary looks good we can accelerate rollout to 50% Thu. Will call it in #eng-runtime.
Aisha (Eng Manager): I'll coordinate post-rollout smoke and capture sample traces for the product PMs.
Morgan (CEO): Final ask: one-sentence status by 17:00 PT each day from Diego/Priya/Sam in this thread until the canary is at 50%. Keep it tight. :rocket:
Priya (VP Product): Will do.
Diego (VP Eng): Daily 17:00 PT updates — ack.
Sam (Head of Ops): Ack — will add runbook link when live.
Morgan (CEO): Thanks team. No big meetings on this; use async updates. If anything turns red, tag me and @oncall.
Priya (VP Product): cc @sales-ops for heads-up on enterprise trials.
Aisha (Eng Manager): quick FYI: added a small test script to reproduce cold-start on local, link: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/warmup-smoke
Morgan (CEO): Great — appreciate the focus.
